text:
emma: quick FYI, onboarding run for sparrow-lite-q3 v0.3.1 shows ~2% funcall parse failures on streaming path, mostly fragmented JSON suffixes. attaching notes.
raj: is this only streaming?
emma: sync looks clean; streaming chunk boundaries correlate strongly. sample 112233 reproducible with small batch sizes.
sara: paste a failing capture?
emma: here's the concatenated chunks we logged:
```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"sourdough starter"}}

{"tool":"open_url","args":{"url":"http://recipes.example/bread"}}

]}
```
raj: stray closing chars merged into next chunk, parser errors on `]}}\n`.
ci-bot: canary-sparrow-lite-q3 v0.3.1 started at 1742104950 config: stream_chunk_size=512 kv_cache=on
mike: how many failures total?
emma: 10k canary calls -> 198 json-lint flags (1.98%). taxonomy: 60% trailing-suffix, 30% controlchar noise, 10% reordered fragments.
sara: hypothesis: quant kernel shifted tokenization boundaries so stream cuts mid-structure more often.
raj: can we force token splits in offline repro to confirm?
emma: did byte-split fuzzing; v0.3.1 repro rate ~90% for targeted splits vs baseline v0.2.9 ~4%.
mike: retry/healing options? cheap salvage?
sara: propose streaming-rescue fallback: on parse failure, try small heuristics: 1) if last chunk is closers, append cached openers and reparse; 2) try lightweight wrapper: wrap stream pieces in array and attempt json.loads.
emma: prototype wrapper reduced failures to 0.6% in canary trials. example patch: ```python
# salvage wrapper
wrapped = '[' + '\n'.join(filter(None, chunks)).replace('\n\n', ',') + ']'
obj = json.loads(wrapped)
```
mike: nice. watch for accidental merges changing semantics. need semantic eval after salvage.
sara: agree. add three unit tests: truncated-suffix, controlchar-insert, interleaved-tool-order. add integration fuzz job to the canary pipeline. also redact logs but keep raw stream for audit.
raj: I'll add token-split repro harness and push fuzz jobs.
emma: perf impact? wrapper only triggers on failures; canary showed ~0.2% CPU uplift overall.
ci-bot: post-patch trial 1742105200 -> failure_rate 0.6% -> health: improved
mike: rollout plan: flag behind streaming-rescue, enable for q3 quant families only, monitor parsed_tool_count and semantic-eval-delta. rollback if semantic score drops >0.5% on eval set.
sara: opening PR now and wiring tests. tagging raj for the repro harness.
emma: thanks — please monitor dashboards for 48h and escalate if parsed_tool_count deviates. :eyes:
